title: Driver Distraction Detection
desc: YOLOv10 model that spots 12 distracted-driving behaviours in images and video, optimised with ONNX Runtime. Published at IEEE ICCIT 2025.

card.lede: A YOLOv10 model that watches the driver and flags distraction as it happens. Published at IEEE ICCIT 2025.
points: Spots 12 behaviours, from texting and phone calls to drinking and drowsiness
Works on photos and on video, frame by frame
Runs on ONNX Runtime, deployed with Docker through CI/CD
